title: Machine and Gravity Again
author: Juniper Galloway
blurb: Elodie Marchetti, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
